sections.heading: Design
paragraphs: Pilot EX-17 compares a saved template workflow with repeated manual filters. Eight operators at three synthetic test sites ran both workflows using the same date range and metrics.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: Median setup time fell from 91 seconds to 29 seconds. One participant selected a template for the wrong region because the region was visible only in the details panel.

sections.heading: Decision
paragraphs: Keep the feature in pilot. Add region to the template selector and repeat the usability check before launch.
